incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall Priya for SEV2 - GPU capacity exhaustion observed in us-west-2 inference cluster. Root thread created at 1711254321

Priya (oncall): seeing high queue depth on /v1/generate, autoscaler didn't add nodes. queue_depth ~ 340 -> 800 over last 12m. throttled_reqs spiking, first 503s reported. Investigating.

Jamal (sre): I'm in. checking node pool metrics and ASG activity. autoscaler events show 'scale suppressed - max nodes reached' at 1711254200. Which policy was attached to the pool?

Leah (eng-runtime): adding context: we rolled a new runtime build yesterday with MIG sizing changes (default 1x40g -> split to 4x10g) to improve density. That might create fragmentation for large-model pods.

Priya (oncall): customers reporting increased latency and 503s. Carlos, any high-priority customers to call out?

Carlos (product): Affected: beta-corp and search-proto (both high request volume). Beta-corp has SLOs; they just opened a support ticket. Need ETA for mitigation.

Jamal (sre): ASG shows we are at the committed cap (reserved nodes) and burst limit flagged. Autoscaler attempted scale -> failed due to account-level GPU quota. See cloud-account error: "QuotaExceeded: GPU core quota exceeded".

Priya (oncall): so two simultaneous issues: quota preventing autoscaling + fragmentation from MIG splits causing stranded capacity. Can we manually add capacity with different node type?

Leah (eng-runtime): I'm seeing many nodes with >60% free GPU but split into small MIG slices that can't satisfy the slot request for our 40g model containers. Scheduler binpacking fails because pods require single contiguous GPU of ~30-40g. Example: node-a has 4x10g free but not a 40g slice -> effectively stranded.

Jamal (sre): copying relevant logs: ```[autoscaler] scale_attempt: desired=0->10 reason=queue_depth threshold breached; error: QuotaExceeded: Requested 8 GPU cores, available 0```

Priya (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle non-essential routes (safelists) to reduce queue growth. 2) manual scale-up of a new node pool with full-size GPU (A100 80GB) and different MIG config (no slicing) and force-schedule heavy pods there. 3) adjust scheduler tolerations/affinities to binpack large-model pods onto unsliced nodes. 4) open urgent quota increase with cloud support.

Leah (eng-runtime): I'll prepare a runtime tweak: add nodeSelector for label node-type=unsliced-largegpu for heavy-model DaemonSet. Also apply temporary patch to controller to prefer nodes with free contiguous GPU capacity.

Jamal (sre): executing manual scale now. Command: ```cloudctl compute nodepool create --region us-west-2 --name emergency-largegpu --instance g5.12xlarge --gpu-type a100-80gb --count 6``` Returning output...

deploy-bot: create nodepool job queued (job id 3829). Estimated attach time 6m.

Priya (oncall): throttling rules: Leah/Carlos, please confirm which endpoints are non-essential to throttle. We need to reduce queue by ~40% quickly.

Carlos (product): throttle experimental and internal testing routes: /v1/embeddings-test, /v1/debug, and streaming playgrounds. Keep customer-facing gen endpoints at reduced rate. I'll update support notes for Beta-corp.

ops-bot: Rate limit change applied: /v1/embeddings-test -> 10r/m, /v1/debug -> off, streaming -> 50% concurrency. Effective 1711254500.

Jamal (sre): nodepool creation succeeded at 1711254830; new nodes joining k8s. Kube events: new nodes Ready at 1711254985, 1711255002, 1711255061.

Leah (eng-runtime): patching runtime scheduler: ```kubectl -n inference patch deployment runtime-scheduler --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"affinity":{"nodeAffinity":{"requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution":{"nodeSelectorTerms":[{"matchExpressions":[{"key":"node-type","operator":"In","values":["unsliced-largegpu"]}]}]}}}}}}'```

Leah (eng-runtime): rerouting heavy model pods to unsliced pool. Scaling deployment redwood-runtime to 12 replicas to absorb queue. ```kubectl -n inference scale deployment redwood-runtime --replicas=12```

Priya (oncall): monitoring queue_depth and throttled_reqs. queue_depth fell from 800 -> 320 within 4m after nodes came up and throttles applied. 503s reduced but still intermittent for long-context requests.

Jamal (sre): cloud support acknowledged quota request (case #CS-7173). They indicate ~30-45m for quota increase. Meanwhile we have 6 new unsliced nodes; scheduler moved 8 heavy pods successfully. Some small pods still stuck.

Leah (eng-runtime): root cause summary so far: 1) aggressive MIG slicing in previous rollout increased density but caused fragmentation for large-model workloads. 2) autoscaler blocked by cloud GPU quota - prevented reactive scale. 3) packed small MIG slices left free capacity that couldn't satisfy large pod requests -> stranded capacity. We'll need longer-term action.

Priya (oncall): Customer impact: Beta-corp experienced ~12 minutes of 503s and elevated latency; search-proto saw degraded tail latency for ~18 minutes. No data loss, requests retried by clients. Logged to incidents.

Carlos (product): I notified Beta-corp with mitigation steps and ETA for permanent fix. They asked for postmortem and action items.

Jamal (sre): immediate follow-ups for postmortem: - revert default MIG config or make it workload-aware - add quota guard in autoscaler to detect account-level quotas and fallback to alternative pools - implement 'defragmentation' binpacking job that can consolidate small-slice pods to free contiguous slices - add alert for 'stranded_gpu_capacity' when free GPU but unschedulable pods > X

Leah (eng-runtime): I'll open an RFC for workload-aware MIG profiles and scheduler heuristics. Also will add a controller to prefer consolidation and automated pod eviction for compaction windows (non-critical pods).

Priya (oncall): Handoff to Jamal for follow-up on SRE actions and to Leah for runtime changes. I'm going offline in 25m; leaving incident in monitoring state.

Jamal (sre): ack. I'll keep monitoring and update thread. Current metrics at 1711256000: queue_depth=120, throttled_reqs=15/s, 503_rate=0.2% over 5m.

Leah (eng-runtime): created ticket INFRT-1345: "MIG fragmentation -> stranded capacity: analysis + mitigation" with initial notes and playbook.

Priya (oncall): closing active page. If metrics regress above thresholds, incident-bot please escalate to SEV1.

incident-bot: Incident state moved to 'monitoring' by Priya at 1711256227.

Jamal (sre): postmortem owners: Jamal/Leah/Carlos. ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow.

Carlos (product): I'll coordinate customer comms and include mitigation timeline. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Priya (oncall): good job everyone. Leaving notes in oncall doc.
